Name: Lallan Ji Yadav
Profile:
- Retired IAS Officer (2017)
- Retired as a Commissioner of Koshi commissionary in 2017.
- Worked as a DM in Nawada (2013-15) & Katihar District (2015-17).
- He joined JD(U) in 2017 and was Sanghtan Prabhari of Katihar (2017-20).
- His father (Late Professor Bhagwat Prasad Yadav) was MLA from Jamalpur AC in 1967-68.
